templates_unsuccessful_body.name: templates_unsuccessful_body
templates_unsuccessful_body.default:
'Thank you for trialling with Rowville Eagles. We’ve had a great number of players this season, and on this occasion we’re unable to offer {player} a place in a {ageGroup} team. We know this is disappointing.

We’d love {player} to keep playing — we’ll keep their details in case a spot opens up, and you’re welcome to contact us for feedback.'

what_to_bring.name: what_to_bring
what_to_bring.default: 'Boots, shin pads, water bottle and a ball if you have one. Please arrive 10 minutes early.'

shop_pickup_note.name: shop_pickup_note
shop_pickup_note.default: 'Collect from the canteen on training nights'

hero_intro.name: hero_intro
hero_intro.default: 'Paid, professionally trained coaches, a real football curriculum and a year-round program — built so every player knows what they’re working on and what comes next.'

coaches_body.name: coaches_body
coaches_body.default: 'Every session is led by a paid coach who has completed our professional development program. That means qualified, consistent and accountable coaching for your child — every week, all year.'

coaches_more.name: coaches_more
coaches_more.default: 'Before they coach a single session, our coaches complete a 10-week professional development program that teaches them to deliver sessions “the Foundation way”. They learn our lesson sequence, how children learn, how to communicate with and motivate young players, how to break down technique, and how to use constraints to develop it. Just as importantly, they learn who we are — our culture and our values — so every coach is aligned from day one.'

curriculum_body.name: curriculum_body
curriculum_body.default: 'Modelled on the Victorian school curriculum, our football curriculum runs from Foundation level (up to age 7) through every age to 13. Each player follows a clear progression, so players and parents always know what they’re working on and what comes next.'

curriculum_more.name: curriculum_more
curriculum_more.default: 'Each level sets out achievement standards across six strands. Coaches plan sessions against those standards, track progress through the year, and report on it — the same way a good school does.'

sessions_body.name: sessions_body
sessions_body.default: 'Every session is built around one learning objective and follows the same five stages, so players get the most out of every minute.'

sessions_more.name: sessions_more
sessions_more.default: 'Sessions run for 75 minutes for U5–U11 and 90 minutes for U12 and up.'

sessions_lengths.name: sessions_lengths
sessions_lengths.default: '75 minutes for U5–U11 · 90 minutes for U12+'

reports_body.name: reports_body
reports_body.default: 'Once or twice a year, coaches assess each player against the curriculum’s achievement standards in every strand. Reports live on your child’s profile in the player portal, so you can see their progress over time.'

reports_more.name: reports_more
reports_more.default: 'Each strand is assessed on a five-point scale — Well below, Below, At, Above or Well above the standard for their level — with a short comment from the coach on what’s going well and what to work on next.'

year_body.name: year_body
year_body.default: 'We run all four Victorian school terms, so development doesn’t stop when the season does — around 80–100 training sessions a year.'

year_more.name: year_more
year_more.default: 'In the off-season (Terms 1 and 4) players train twice a week with the Rowville Foundation Academy. In season (Terms 2 and 3) they train twice a week with their team and play weekly games, with an optional third academy session focused on their personal targets.'

pathways_body.name: pathways_body
pathways_body.default: 'Players can be Rowville players in our club teams, Rowville Foundation Academy players, or both. Players from other clubs are welcome in the academy and stay connected to Rowville — and you can join part-way through the season through the academy, even when teams are full.'

pathways_more.name: pathways_more
pathways_more.default: 'The academy and the club share the same curriculum and coaching approach, so moving between them — or doing both — is seamless.'

community_body.name: community_body
community_body.default: 'Every Friday night is for families: a fun-only game, a free dinner, music and dessert. It’s our way of bringing back the community and culture we feel football has lost.'

community_more.name: community_more
community_more.default: 'Dinner is usually pizza. There’s nothing to book — just rock up. We only ask that a parent or carer stays to supervise their child.'

community_when.name: community_when
community_when.default: 'Fridays at 5:30pm during Victorian school terms (not school holidays)'

fplus_headline.name: fplus_headline
fplus_headline.default: 'Foundation+: training that keeps going at home'

fplus_body.name: fplus_body
fplus_body.default: 'Our online training platform: levelled drills in six areas, video challenges checked by Academy coaches, badges and leaderboards.'

cta_body.name: cta_body
cta_body.default: 'Book into the academy, register interest for a team, or start a free month of Foundation+.'

voicemail_greeting.name: voicemail_greeting
voicemail_greeting.default: 'Thanks for calling Foundation Academy. We can’t take your call right now. Please leave your name, your child’s name and a message after the tone, and we’ll call you back as soon as we can.'

tagline.name: tagline
tagline.default: 'Level up your game — skills, challenges, badges and coach feedback.'
